text: Vitruvius recommends northern light for picture galleries because it varies less, and eastern exposure for bedrooms and libraries because their use needs morning light. These are room-by-room prescriptions in an Augustan Roman architectural manual (Book VI.4).
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Vitruvius, De architectura, Augustan Roman world, translated by Morris Hicky Morgan (1914), public-domain primary text; https://www.gutenberg.org/files/20239/20239-h/20239-h.htm . Verified primary context: Book VI.4.1-2; chapter also specified in the stimulus.
